dialogues.jp: ほのかに明るい部屋で、ずっと横になっている。
dialogues.en: I've been lying down in a slightly bright room.
dialogues.text: I've been lying down in a slightly bright room.

dialogues.jp:
時計の短針が１２をさしているが、一向に起き
る気にならない。
dialogues.en:
The short hand on the clock was pointing at 12, but I didn't
feel like waking up.
dialogues.text:
The short hand on the clock was pointing at 12, but I didn't
feel like waking up.

dialogues.jp:
胃袋が何か言っている気がするが、何もしたく
なかった。
dialogues.en:
My stomach was rumbling but I didn't feel like doing
anything about it.
dialogues.text:
My stomach was rumbling but I didn't feel like doing
anything about it.

dialogues.jp:
布団をかぶり、強く目を閉じる。何も聞きたく
なかったし、見たくもなかった。
dialogues.en:
I covered myself with a blanket and closed my eyes. I didn't
want to hear or see anything.
dialogues.text:
I covered myself with a blanket and closed my eyes. I didn't
want to hear or see anything.

dialogues.jp: そして、何も思い出したくなかった……。
dialogues.en:
More than anything, I didn't want to think about what
happened......
dialogues.text:
More than anything, I didn't want to think about what
happened......

dialogues.jp: ガチャ――。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ただいまぁ〜♪」
dialogues.en: "I'm home!!"
dialogues.text: "I'm home!!"

dialogues.jp: 下の階から音夢の幻聴が聞こえる。
dialogues.en:
I heard an auditory hallucination of Nemu's voice from
downstairs.
dialogues.text:
I heard an auditory hallucination of Nemu's voice from
downstairs.

dialogues.jp: （もう、俺ダメかもしんない……）
dialogues.en: (I'm not going to make it......)
dialogues.text: (I'm not going to make it......)

dialogues.jp: 死を覚悟しつつ、それでもいいかもと思う。
dialogues.en: I was ready to die and it didn't bother me one bit.
dialogues.text: I was ready to die and it didn't bother me one bit.

dialogues.jp: ガチャ――
dialogues.en: Click......
dialogues.text: Click......

dialogues.jp: リリン――
dialogues.en: Ding-a-ling.
dialogues.text: Ding-a-ling.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もう兄さんったら、可愛い妹が帰って来るっ
　ていう日に、なに眠ってるのよっ」
dialogues.en:
"Hey Niisan! Your cute sister's back! What are you doing
there sleeping?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey Niisan! Your cute sister's back! What are you doing
there sleeping?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……やけにハッキリとした幻聴だ」
dialogues.en: "......This hallucination sounds so real......"
dialogues.text: "......This hallucination sounds so real......"

dialogues.jp: ゴスッ――！
「ぐふっ！」
dialogues.en: "Ugh!"
dialogues.text: "Ugh!"

dialogues.jp:
幻聴が聞こえた直後、｛みぞおち／鳩尾｝に懐かしい刺激――
もとい、激痛が走る。
dialogues.en:
After I heard the hallucination, I felt a pain I haven't had
in a while......
dialogues.text:
After I heard the hallucination, I felt a pain I haven't had
in a while......

dialogues.jp: ガバッと上体を起こすと――。
dialogues.en: I quickly got up......
dialogues.text: I quickly got up......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう兄さん。目、覚めた♪」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, niisan. Are you up now?"
dialogues.text: "Good morning, niisan. Are you up now?"

dialogues.jp:
とても嬉しそうに、音夢が俺の顔を覗き込んで
くる。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked into my face with a joyful look.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked into my face with a joyful look.

dialogues.en: "......Is this a dream?"
dialogues.text: "......Is this a dream?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まだ、寝ぼけてる？」
dialogues.en: "Are you still out of it?"
dialogues.text: "Are you still out of it?"

dialogues.jp: 国語辞典が｛・・・・／両手持ち｝で振り上げられる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was holding a dictionary in both hands, and getting
ready to smack me.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was holding a dictionary in both hands, and getting
ready to smack me.

dialogues.jp: 「いえ、もうバッチリ目覚めております！」
dialogues.en: "No, I'm wide awake now!"
dialogues.text: "No, I'm wide awake now!"

dialogues.jp: 慌ててベッドの上に起き上がる。
dialogues.en: I sat up on the bed in a hurry.
dialogues.text: I sat up on the bed in a hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もう、私がいないと起きることもできないん
　だから」
dialogues.en: "You can't even wake up without me."
dialogues.text: "You can't even wake up without me."

dialogues.jp: うれしそうに目を細める。
dialogues.en: She smiled joyfully.
dialogues.text: She smiled joyfully.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「朝食用意しておいてあげるから、さっさと着
　替えて下りてきてね♪」
dialogues.en:
"I'll make you some breakfast, so get changed and come
downstairs, ok?"
dialogues.text:
"I'll make you some breakfast, so get changed and come
downstairs, ok?"

dialogues.jp:
少々はしゃぎ気味に言うと、音夢がベッドから
下りていく。
dialogues.en: She spoke with excitement and went away from my bed.
dialogues.text: She spoke with excitement and went away from my bed.

dialogues.jp: リン――
dialogues.en: Ding-a-ling.
dialogues.text: Ding-a-ling.

dialogues.jp: 鈴の音を残して、音夢がドアの陰に消える。
dialogues.en: I heard the bell ring and Nemu disappeared behind the door.
dialogues.text: I heard the bell ring and Nemu disappeared behind the door.

dialogues.jp: 「……夢、じゃないよな？」
dialogues.en: "......It's not a dream, right?"
dialogues.text: "......It's not a dream, right?"

dialogues.jp:
ベッドから下り、思わず床の固さを確かめてし
まった。
dialogues.en:
I got out of the bed and made sure the floor was actually
there.
dialogues.text:
I got out of the bed and made sure the floor was actually
there.

dialogues.jp:
しかし……音夢の浮かれた笑顔のおかげで、少
しばかり元気が出てきてしまった気がする。
dialogues.en:
Seeing Nemu's joyful smile made me feel a little
better......
dialogues.text:
Seeing Nemu's joyful smile made me feel a little
better......

dialogues.jp: 「しゃーない……行くか」
dialogues.en: "Oh well, I guess I'll go downstairs......"
dialogues.text: "Oh well, I guess I'll go downstairs......"

dialogues.jp:
パジャマから着替えて“家族のいる”居間に向
かうことにした。
dialogues.en:
I got changed and went to the living room to see my family
member.
dialogues.text:
I got changed and went to the living room to see my family
member.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう」
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."

dialogues.jp: 改めて朝の挨拶を交わし、テーブルの席に着く。
dialogues.en: We greeted each other again, and I sat on the chair.
dialogues.text: We greeted each other again, and I sat on the chair.

dialogues.jp:
すぐに、目の前に香ばしい匂いのトーストが用
意された。
dialogues.en: She placed an appetizing piece of toast in front of me.
dialogues.text: She placed an appetizing piece of toast in front of me.

dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、どうして帰って来たんだ？　
　停学でもくらったか？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, why are you back at home? Did you get suspended
or something?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way, why are you back at home? Did you get suspended
or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「違います。ゴールデンウィークだもん、帰省
　ぐらいします」
dialogues.en: "No. It's the Golden Week vacation. That's why I came home."
dialogues.text: "No. It's the Golden Week vacation. That's why I came home."

dialogues.jp:
軽口にむくれる音夢の反応に、ホッとする懐か
しさを感じる。
dialogues.en: I felt right at home as I saw Nemu getting mad at my joke.
dialogues.text: I felt right at home as I saw Nemu getting mad at my joke.

dialogues.jp:
「帰ってくるんなら、連絡ぐらいよこせば出迎
　えてやったのに」
dialogues.en:
"If you were coming back, you should have given me a call. I
would've come and got you."
dialogues.text:
"If you were coming back, you should have given me a call. I
would've come and got you."

dialogues.jp: 家でだけど。
dialogues.en: I would've met her at the front door.
dialogues.text: I would've met her at the front door.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「連絡ならしました」
dialogues.en: "I did call you."
dialogues.text: "I did call you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いつ？」
dialogues.en: "When?"
dialogues.text: "When?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「昨日、夕方と夜に何度も」
dialogues.en:
"I called several times yesterday in the evening and at
night."
dialogues.text:
"I called several times yesterday in the evening and at
night."

dialogues.jp:
そう言えば、｛ふさ／塞｝ぎこんでいる時にそんなＢＧＭ
を何度か耳にしたような……。
dialogues.en:
I do remember hearing something yesterday when I was feeling
depressed......
dialogues.text:
I do remember hearing something yesterday when I was feeling
depressed......

dialogues.jp: 「すまんな……昨日は……かったるくてな」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry...... I was too tired yesterday......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry...... I was too tired yesterday......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう、重要な電話だったらどうするのよ」
dialogues.en: "What were you going to do if it was an important call?"
dialogues.text: "What were you going to do if it was an important call?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そんな重要な電話なんて、そうそうかかって
　こないって。あったとしても、もう手遅れだ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't get important calls that often. If it was
important, it's too late now."
dialogues.text:
"I don't get important calls that often. If it was
important, it's too late now."

dialogues.jp: 溜め息をつく音夢だが、どこか楽しげでもある。
dialogues.en: She sighed but she looked like she was having fun.
dialogues.text: She sighed but she looked like she was having fun.

dialogues.jp:
かく言う俺も、以前とかわらない音夢との会話
に、気持ちが｛うわ／浮｝ついていた。
dialogues.en:
I was also relieved and excited to have an ordinary
conversation with Nemu.
dialogues.text:
I was also relieved and excited to have an ordinary
conversation with Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
トーストに、マーガリンとジャムをぺたぺたと
塗って、かぶりつく。
dialogues.en: I bit on to the toast with butter and jelly on it.
dialogues.text: I bit on to the toast with butter and jelly on it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ところで兄さん……」
dialogues.en: "By the way, niisan......"
dialogues.text: "By the way, niisan......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 急にしおらしげな声をだす音夢に顔をあげる。
dialogues.en: I looked at Nemu as she spoke to me with an obedient look.
dialogues.text: I looked at Nemu as she spoke to me with an obedient look.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……今日はどこか行ったりしないの？」
dialogues.en: "......Are you going anywhere today?"
dialogues.text: "......Are you going anywhere today?"

dialogues.jp: なぜか遠慮がちに｛き／訊｝いてくる。
dialogues.en: She asked me hesitantly for some reason.
dialogues.text: She asked me hesitantly for some reason.

dialogues.jp: 「？　いや」
dialogues.en: "What? Not really."
dialogues.text: "What? Not really."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、そうなの？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you're not?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, you're not?"

dialogues.jp: 意外そうな顔をする音夢。ちょっと顔が｛ほころ／綻｝ぶ。
dialogues.en: She asked with a surprised face and showed some relief.
dialogues.text: She asked with a surprised face and showed some relief.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「で、でも、ゴールデンウィークなんだし……
　誰かと、どこかに行ったりはするよね？」
dialogues.en:
"But it's Golden Week, so you have something planned with
someone, right?"
dialogues.text:
"But it's Golden Week, so you have something planned with
someone, right?"

dialogues.jp: ちょっと興奮気味に、妙なことを訊いてくる。
dialogues.en:
She was asking me a strange question with excitement in her
voice.
dialogues.text:
She was asking me a strange question with excitement in her
voice.

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩の顔が浮かぶ。
dialogues.en: Suddenly I thought about Moe-sempai's face.
dialogues.text: Suddenly I thought about Moe-sempai's face.

dialogues.jp: 決意のこもった真剣な瞳を――。
dialogues.en: That determined look she had......
dialogues.text: That determined look she had......

dialogues.jp: 「……いや……それもないだろう……」
dialogues.en: "......No...... I don't have any plans......"
dialogues.text: "......No...... I don't have any plans......"

dialogues.jp: 表情を殺して、呟く。
dialogues.en: I muttered without showing any expression.
dialogues.text: I muttered without showing any expression.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Really......?"
dialogues.text: "Really......?"

dialogues.jp: 確かめるように、上目遣いに見つめてくる。
dialogues.en: She looked up at me to make sure.
dialogues.text: She looked up at me to make sure.

dialogues.jp: 少しぶっきらぼうに答える。
dialogues.en: I answered bluntly.
dialogues.text: I answered bluntly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そう」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
音夢が、はしゃいだ声をあげる。暇な理由を考
えると、複雑な気分だが……。
dialogues.en:
Nemu sounded excited. I feel uneasy thinking about why I
don't have any plans......
dialogues.text:
Nemu sounded excited. I feel uneasy thinking about why I
don't have any plans......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、休みの間はずっと一緒だね♪」
dialogues.en: "So we can spend the whole vacation together!"
dialogues.text: "So we can spend the whole vacation together!"

dialogues.jp: ま、いっか――。
dialogues.en: Oh well......
dialogues.text: Oh well......

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢の帰省◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nemu came back◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nemu came back◆

dialogues.jp:
部屋でうだうだしていると、何と、音夢がやっ
て来た。ＧＷ中の帰省なんだそうだ。
dialogues.en:
When I was being lazy in my room, Nemu came back. She came
home for the Golden Week vacation.
dialogues.text:
When I was being lazy in my room, Nemu came back. She came
home for the Golden Week vacation.
